sentences.text:
Dhananjoy Mukherjee @ Hasa vs The State Of West Bengal &
Anr on 3 December, 2025

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 M/L 111 C.R.M. (M) 1584 of 2025
03.12.2025
Bpg.
In Re: An application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure as
amended/under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with
Bakultala Police Station Case No.261 of 2021 dated 07.11.2021 under Sections 376/511/302 of the
Indian Penal Code;
Dhananjoy Mukherjee @ Hasa Versus The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Kallol Kr. Basu Md. Jannat Ul Firdous.
...for the petitioner.

entities.text: Dhananjoy Mukherjee @ Hasa Versus The State of West Bengal & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Kallol Kr. Basu Md. Jannat Ul Firdous
entities.label: LAWYER

sentences.text: Mr. Kaushik Kundu Ms. Debadrita Mondal.

Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for more
than four years and has been implicated for alleged offences under Section 376 of the Indian Penal
Code.

On the other hand, learned advocate appearing for the State submits that the trial of the case is at the verge of conclusion as on the next date the last witness i.e the investigating officer is fixed on 18.12.2025
In view of the last witness being fixed on 18.12.2025, I direct the prosecution to complete their evidence by 31st January, 2026.

Learned trial court would pronounce verdict by 31st March,
2026.
Having considered the belated stage at which the petitioner has approached this Court, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Memo of Evidence filed by the State be kept with the record.
